description: email.rs apply_header_form: AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, and AsURLs forms all return Value::Null with only a comment saying 'not yet implemented'. RFC 8621 §4.1.3 requires these forms to return structured values. A client that requests header:From:asAddresses will silently receive null and may silently discard data without any error. This will generate user reports and is difficult to diagnose. The forms are documented as 'not yet implemented' but there is no error, no validation rejection, and no test asserting that these forms return null — future contributors may not realize they need to implement the parsers.
title: header:*:asAddresses/asDate/asMessageIds/asURLs silently return null
